pr_title: br: fix check sum time inaccurate in restore log
pr_body:
### What problem does this PR solve?

Issue Number: close #29158

Problem Summary:
After restore data to tidb, the BR will do the checksum concurrently, we accumulate all check sum time of each go routines, as a result, the restore check sum time larger than total restore time.

issue_context.title: br: Should print more valid message for checksum-duration
issue_context.body:
## Enhancement

As follow log from `br restore`, maybe it is no sense for "restore-checksum=1h57m24.639772777s" but [total-take=11m43.853700371s]. 
Should we print more valid message for checksum duration?

> [2021/10/21 17:08:09.280 +08:00] [INFO] [collector.go:66] ["Full restore success summary"] [total-ranges=1406] [ranges-succeed=1406] [ranges-failed=0] [split-region=18.662650702s] **[restore-checksum=1h57m24.639772777s]** [restore-ranges=1362] **[total-take=11m43.853700371s]** [restore-data-size(after-compressed)=43.71GB] [Size=43714987368] [BackupTS=428554737544069123] [total-kv=760000000] [total-kv-size=96.52GB] [average-speed=137.1MB/s]
comments: IMO just remove those would be fine...

review_comments: removing this also removes the "table checksum success count" though 🤔

it looks 
						summary.CollectSuccessUnit("table checksum", 1, elapsed)
removing the "table checksum success count" also.

no sure what else I can do?
we keep total checksum success unit.
